description: Audit of bedrock-zsw confirmed index_update.ex lines ~203-215 (if 0 in middle_page_ids) are unreachable: chain traversal uses next_id == 0 as end-of-chain sentinel, so page 0 can only ever be the first collected page, never middle or last. Remove the branch or coveralls-ignore it. Also consider the keys_removed asymmetry: clear_range counts unconditionally while set/clear stats are gated on track_statistics. See PR #78.
title: Remove unreachable page-0-as-middle-page branch in IndexUpdate.clear_range
